therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: insulin sensitization and neuroprotection via PPAR-gamma activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: adults with mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in ADAS-Cog total score at Week 24 stratified by APOE e4 status

results.effect_size: RSG XR 2 mg vs placebo: -0.8 points ADAS-Cog (full population, W24); RSG XR 8 mg vs placebo: -0.8 points ADAS-Cog (full population, W24)
biomarker_changes: HbA1c change from baseline at W24: placebo +0.1%, RSG XR 2 mg +0.2%, RSG XR 8 mg +0.1% (no significant difference)
Hemoglobin decreased dose-dependently with RSG XR 8 mg: -11.9 g/L at W24 vs -1.3 g/L placebo
Hematocrit decreased with RSG XR 8 mg: -0.0326 at W24 vs -0.0010 placebo
Body weight increased with RSG XR: +0.8 kg at W24 for both 2 mg and 8 mg vs -0.3 kg placebo
Cholesterol elevated (PCC) in RSG XR 8 mg: 29/137 vs 7/141 placebo
LDL elevated (PCC) in RSG XR 8 mg: 55/136 vs 36/141 placebo
subgroup_findings: APOE e4-negative cohort: RSG XR 2 mg vs placebo ADAS-Cog difference -1.8 (p=0.074), not significant
All-except-e4/e4 cohort: RSG XR 2 mg vs placebo ADAS-Cog difference -1.2 (p=0.131), not significant
Full population CIBIC+: donepezil vs placebo -0.5 (p=0.009), significant; RSG XR arms not significant
All-except-e4/e4 CIBIC+: donepezil vs placebo -0.5 (p=0.025), significant
MMSE at W24: donepezil vs placebo +1.0 (p=0.030), significant; RSG XR arms not significant
safety_signals: Weight gain observed with RSG XR (21/166 for 2 mg and 25/165 for 8 mg had >=7% increase vs 9/165 placebo)
Hemoglobin and hematocrit decreased dose-dependently with RSG XR 8 mg
Congestive cardiac failure: 1 case in RSG XR 2 mg arm (SAE)
Myocardial infarction: 1 case in RSG XR 2 mg arm (SAE)
Cardiac failure: 1 case in placebo arm (SAE)
Acute myocardial infarction: 1 case in donepezil arm (SAE)
Elevated cholesterol and LDL values of potential clinical concern more frequent in RSG XR 8 mg arm
DBP decrease >=20 mmHg: 25 in RSG XR 8 mg vs 8 placebo
SBP decrease >=30 mmHg: 15 in RSG XR 8 mg vs 7 placebo

dose_info.dose: 2 mg or 8 mg (rosiglitazone XR); 10 mg (donepezil comparator)

context.investigator_commentary: A hierarchical testing procedure was used to control for the two rosiglitazone dose groups and the three genetic subgroups. Donepezil was included as a sensitivity arm to assess the trial's ability to detect a treatment effect; donepezil showed significant benefit on CIBIC+ and MMSE, confirming assay sensitivity, while neither rosiglitazone dose met its primary endpoints in any APOE e4 subgroup.
